author: _DipperPines
body: So, to back marcwood 501's suggestion, people should get credits for defending. Now, in his thread people were saying that you could get credits by being AFK. Not in my way :). It could count the number of blocks and kills you got within a radius of your monument. If it is over a certain number, then at the end of the match you get credits! Please think about this!
